headline: 末日劇《狂喜》搭上熱浪
context: 英國BBC改編2010年小說《The Rapture》的末日劇，講的是一個陷入極端熱浪與極端主義興起的英國，16年後搬上螢幕，正好碰上今年破紀錄的熱浪，評論形容「來得正是時候」。同一天，《The Odyssey》翻譯者艾蜜莉・威爾森（Emily Wilson）公開批評克里斯多福・諾蘭（Christopher Nolan）改編的電影版本。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: It’s set in a UK racked by an unbearable heatwave and the rise of extremism – this adaptation of the 2010 novel feels horrifyingly apt When The Rapture by Liz Jensen was first published, in 2010, it was set in a near-future when temperatures in the UK are rising to unbearable heights, culty-Christian groups with apocalyptic bents are springing up all over the place and there is a growing sense that the world is going mad. Swap out “culty-Christian” for “political extremists bent on embracing the apocalypse rather than trying to save us from it” and it would be a deluded soul indeed who wouldn’t place it among fiction’s more prescient offerings. The adaptation that has arrived on our screens 16 years later – a study in physical and mental discomfort – is the perfect accompaniment to our current record-breaking, fear-inducing heatwave, and gains a lot of power from our growing collective awareness that the future is finally here. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The Hallmark Channel’s ropey version of The Odyssey is going viral for its star-studded cast. Christopher Nolan’s film only looks better by comparison Christopher Nolan ’s version of The Odyssey is far from the first committed to screen. As early as 1911, Italian director Guiseppe de Liguoro made a silent version entitled L’Odissea. Readers of a certain age may remember watching the futuristic animated series Ulysses 31 throughout the 1980s. O Brother, Where Art Thou? is based on The Odyssey. So too, if you squint as hard as you can and discount the Goofy Goober song, is the first SpongeBob SquarePants movie. However, the pre-Nolan adaptation that has the biggest legacy is arguably Andrei Konchalovsky’s two-part version, made in 1997 for the Hallmark Channel. This is the adaptation that has been doing the rounds in recent days, clipped up on social media (the full version is highly discoverable on YouTube) and catching the eye of Joyce Carol Oates , who spent much of Thursday night tweeting very enthusiastically about it. thread_text:
末日劇《狂喜》搭上熱浪

英國BBC改編2010年小說《The Rapture》推出末日劇，故事講的是一個陷入極端熱浪與極端主義興起的英國。小說寫成16年後才搬上螢幕，卻正好碰上今年破紀錄的熱浪，評論形容這齣劇「來得正是時候」。

同一天，《The Odyssey》的翻譯者艾蜜莉・威爾森（Emily Wilson）公開砲轟克里斯多福・諾蘭（Christopher Nolan）改編的電影版本，說自己「連寫過其中任何一部分都會感到羞恥」。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
英國BBC把2010年出版的小說《The Rapture》改編成末日劇搬上螢幕。原著寫的是一個陷入極端熱浪、極端主義興起的近未來英國，16年後才拍成影集，卻正好碰上今年破紀錄的熱浪，評論形容這齣劇「來得正是時候」，看的時候格外有種不寒而慄的既視感。

同一天，古典史詩《The Odyssey》的知名翻譯者艾蜜莉・威爾森（Emily Wilson），公開砲轟克里斯多福・諾蘭（Christopher Nolan）正在籌拍的電影改編版本，直言自己「連寫過其中任何一部分都會感到羞恥」，用詞相當不留情面。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈的報導。
voice_text:
有一部末日劇，上映的時機巧合得有點嚇人。

英國BBC把2010年出版的小說《The Rapture》改編成影集，故事講的是一個陷入極端熱浪、極端主義興起的英國。小說寫成16年後才拍成劇，卻正好碰上今年破紀錄的熱浪，評論說這齣劇「來得正是時候」。

同一天，另一則文化圈話題是——《The Odyssey》的翻譯者艾蜜莉・威爾森公開砲轟克里斯多福・諾蘭正在籌拍的電影改編版，說自己連寫過其中一部分都會感到羞恥，用詞毫不留情。
